clubs.name: Tech Spectrum
clubs.description: The premier technological wing of BC Creative Spectrum. Focuses on full-stack development, software engineering, algorithms, and real-world project development.
clubs.audition_process:
1. Short online logic & coding assessment.
2. 10-minute technical interview discussing your project interest.

clubs.name: Nexus Cultural
clubs.description: The beating heart of expression at BCS. Brings together dancers, actors, stage performers, and theatrical artists for major college events and national fests.
clubs.audition_process:
1. 1-to-2 minute live solo performance (Dance/Drama/Mono-act).
2. Brief interaction with cultural leads.

clubs.name: Pixel Crafts
clubs.description: Visual storytellers and digital creators. Mastering graphic design, UI/UX wireframing, motion graphics, video editing, and 3D artwork.
clubs.audition_process:
1. Showcase your portfolio or sample graphics/video reel.
2. On-spot 20-minute design challenge based on a given prompt.

clubs.name: Code Catalyst
clubs.description: Delving into artificial intelligence, machine learning models, cloud computing, and ethical hacking through hands-on workshops and hackathons.
clubs.audition_process:
1. Quiz on Python/C++/Data Basics.
2. Discussion on AI/ML or Security concepts you are passionate about.

clubs.name: Innovators Club
clubs.description: Cultivating business minds, startup founders, event organizers, and public relations managers for corporate outreach and fest execution.
clubs.audition_process:
1. Group discussion on a business case scenario.
2. Personal interview focusing on leadership and management skills.

clubs.name: Rhythm & Beats
clubs.description: Vocalists, instrumentalists, beatmakers, and audio production enthusiasts organizing live acoustic sessions, bands, and college anthems.
clubs.audition_process:
1. Perform one song/instrumental piece of your choice (up to 2 mins).
2. Scale check and pitch assessment.

clubs.name: Cyber Esports
clubs.description: Bringing together competitive gamers, tournament shoutcasters, stream managers, and aspiring indie game developers.
clubs.audition_process:
1. 1v1 or team tactical match evaluation.
2. Interview on game strategy or game engine knowledge (Unity/Unreal).

clubs.name: Literary Wave
clubs.description: The official editorial, debating, and creative writing guild. Editing college magazines, hosting MUNs, debates, and poetry slams.
clubs.audition_process:
1. 300-word written essay or poem submission.
2. 2-minute impromptu speaking round (Extempore).

announcements.title: Welcome to BC Creative Spectrum Auditions 2026!
announcements.description: Auditions for all 8 clubs are officially open! Registered students can select up to 2 clubs to give auditions. Check the club notices for dates and audition guidelines.
